instruction: Look at `bare.sch`, load the bundled `linear.lbr` into the project, place a 555 timer from that library on the sheet as part `U1`, and save the schematic as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch` must parse as EAGLE XML. 2. Its `<libraries>` block must contain a `<library name="linear">`. 3. Its `<parts>` block must contain at least one part from library `linear` whose deviceset contains `555`. 4. At least one such 555 part must be named `U1`. 5. `U1` must be placed on the sheet via an `<instance>`.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(15); pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter')
